description:
Exceptionally well-maintained split-level home in Woodland Hills offering comfort, views, and exciting future potential. The entry opens to a spacious, light-filled living room with fireplace and large windows, flowing easily into the dining area, kitchen, and backyard patio. The kitchen features maple cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and flexible laundry options with space in the kitchen and additional hookups in the garage.

Upstairs are all three bedrooms and two bathrooms, including a private primary suite with vessel sink, granite vanity, floor-to-ceiling tile, and glass-enclosed shower. The home also features ample closet space, dual-pane windows, durable vinyl plank flooring, central HVAC, a 2-car garage, RV Parking, and a paid-off solar system that fully powers the home with additional LADWP Credits to spare. 

The backyard has endless potential including a large covered patio with built-in BBQ, terraced hillside garden, and stairs leading to a flat viewing area at the top of the lot with valley and mountain views. With potential for expanded outdoor living, future development, or possible ADU use, this is a rare opportunity in a convenient Woodland Hills location near the Village, shops, restaurants, hiking, outdoor recreation, beaches, schools, and the emerging Rams/Warner Center development. Some images may have been edited and / or digitally enhanced.
